name: spectre-manifest-workspace
description: Workspace for the Spectre manifest package and schema tooling.
author: PHCDevworks

scripts.test: corepack pnpm --filter @phcdevworks/spectre-manifest build && corepack pnpm --filter @phcdevworks/spectre-manifest test
scripts.validate:manifest: corepack pnpm --filter @phcdevworks/spectre-manifest build && corepack pnpm --filter @phcdevworks/spectre-manifest validate ../../spectre.manifest.json
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm validate:manifest && npm run check:version-sync
